_readme: Hand-maintained competitive-structure overrides for the Research Library's
'Position' column. Everything else in that column is COMPUTED: market-cap
rank and share of peer cap within the ticker's yfinance industry.
Add an entry only when you know the real market structure, because market
cap is a proxy for size, not share — the two diverge exactly where it
matters (a sole-source supplier can rank #2 by cap in its industry).
An entry here overrides the computed label in the table.
This file ships empty on purpose: an unverified market-share claim in a
trading tool is worse than no claim. Fill it in from your own research.
'structure' is the short label shown in the cell; 'note' is the tooltip.
